# Infrastructure Cost Analyzer

Analyze cloud infrastructure costs and suggest optimizations.

## Cost Drivers
- Compute instances (right-size)
- Storage (lifecycle policies)
- Data transfer (CDN, caching)
- Database (reserved vs on-demand)

## Optimization Strategies
- Use spot/preemptible instances
- Implement auto-scaling
- Archive old data to cold storage
- Consolidate underutilized resources
